   The grinder has a new 'feature'. Formerly the grind width to be used was
   computed from (LINEL (OR (CAR OUTFILES) T)). As this is prone to be
   heuristic, the variable GRLINEL (default UNBOUND) will have priority
   if it is given a value.
----
This change has been installed on all 4 ITS sites as GFN version 456. 
The above information is also available in MC:LISP;NEW RECENT for later
inclusion into .INFO.;LISP NEWS by someone who knows how to do that. Can
someone also install this on non-ITS's, sending me mail saying which ones
it should be shipped to when such fixes are made? Thanks.
-kmp
